cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

mechanism: A coaches its pupil ordinary portioning and catching skills into a concrete act that only makes sense for a hungry ceiling.
confusable: Not demanding abstract belief: A keeps asking B to invert a portion and position a catcher for the ceiling meal.
comparison: Feeding overhead surface versus accommodating two times of one guest.
